title: Checkout
subtitle: One step and your order is placed. No account needed.
emptyText: Add some products to your cart first so you can check out.
deliveryPick: Choose a governorate so we can calculate shipping and the delivery date.
terms: I agree to the <termsLink>Terms and Conditions</termsLink> and the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>

errors.name: Enter your full name (at least 3 characters)
errors.phone: Enter a valid Egyptian mobile number, like 01012345678
errors.email: Enter a valid email or leave it empty
errors.address: Enter the full address (at least 8 characters)
errors.terms: You need to agree to the terms to continue
errors.invalid: Some details in the order are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.outOfStock: Sorry, there is not enough stock of “{name}”. Edit your cart and try again.
errors.outOfStockGeneric: Sorry, an item in your cart does not have enough stock. Edit your cart and try again.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong while placing your order. Please try again shortly.
errors.noPayment: No payment methods are available right now. Please try again shortly.
